== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Dornoth]] IV, also referred to as [[Dornoth]] Four, is the homeworld of the [[Lichborn]] species and is situated within the [[Dornoth system]], which is part of the [[Galactic Union]]. The planet is characterized by an extremely hostile environment, earning it a reputation as the most inhospitable inhabited world in the galaxy. Its landscape is defined by toxic conditions, including acid clouds, sulfurous atmosphere, and poisonous swamps that host various venomous creatures. The surface is also littered with the remains of early spacefaring vessels that were never fully explored due to these dangerous conditions. The planet's [[World Spirit]] actively challenges its [[inhabitants]] by creating various environmental hazards, such as skin-burrowing parasites. While the planetary population is relatively small at approximately one hundred million, billions of people reside on space stations throughout the surrounding system. The [[Vallenar Corporation]] maintains a significant presence on the planet, and it serves as a location for various space-faring activities, including the use of heavy shuttles and salvage operations.}}

== The Captain ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|[[Dornoth]] IV is a toxic landscape characterized by the presence of poisonous flames. The narrator spent their formative years growing up on this volatile planet. Throughout its surface, the world is littered with the remains of early spacefaring vehicle wreckage. Additionally, the planet serves as a source for broadcasting [[Subline]] feeds.}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Dornoth]] IV is a location first identified within a security consultation note. As the homeworld of the [[Lichborn]], it serves as the destination to which the [[Lichborn fleet]] is set to return. The planet is also home to an orphanage where [[Sola Kalter|Sola]] and [[Ortila]] once met, and it remains the place where [[Sola Kalter|Sola]]'s relatives reside.}}
